notes: Replace every criterion that does not apply to this stack with one that does, and never delete a criterion.
Raise the criteria floor when a criterion is added. Never lower it to make the score pass.
Adapt the layer paths, the data layer directory, and the actor parameter pattern to this repository.
The layers of layers.order run from the outermost to the innermost. A layer may reach the layers below it and never the layers above it.
The escape hatches were replaced by the lintRules check, which runs the linter against a file that breaks each rule and holds the linter to it.
The local gate and the merge gate were replaced by the yamlSteps check, which reads the steps of the file and holds a step that only prints a command, is guarded off, or swallows its own failure.
The ratchet document was replaced by the documentSections check, which reads the headings of the document and holds the procedure it names.
The mistake log was replaced by the logRows check, which reads the table of the log and holds a row that names no guardrail that exists.
The entry point was replaced by the entryPointKinds check, which reads the kind of every rule and holds the kind. A path that exists is not enforcement, so the kind decides how the path is checked.
The proofs criterion was replaced by the exactSet check, which holds the cases to the exact set the prover holds, and runs the prover.
The behavioural criterion drives the app end to end. Replace the command with the end to end command of this repository.
The artifact criterion holds the build output to the sources. Replace the artifact path, the build command and the strings with the ones of this repository.

This repository holds one toolchain, so the second toolchain slot holds the typecheck gate. A repository with a second language toolchain replaces this slot with that toolchain's gate, for example cargo test, and records the replacement here.

When a case is added to the proofs array, add its name to the list the prover holds and to the list the scorer holds, and raise the proof floor in the same change. The two files must hold the same names.

The mistake log holds the mistakes of this repository. A fresh repository has made none, so the log criterion passes a log with no rows and says so. Every row that exists must name a guardrail path that exists.

Every rule of AGENTS.md names its enforcement as `Enforced by: <kind>:<path>`, where the kind is config, file, command or document. There is no space after the colon, because the kind and the path are one token.

The scorer writes a probe file to run the linter, and it leaves the tree exactly as it found it, on every exit path. A run that was killed outright leaves a journal outside the tree, and the next run restores the tree from that journal before it writes anything of its own.
